market_outlook.short_term: Volatile. Oil-driven inflation fears and bond selloff cap upside; bargain buying supports S&P 500 recovery. Iran war headlines create whipsaw. Yen intervention risk adds FX noise. Expect 2-3% range-bound trading with energy outperforming.
market_outlook.long_term: Constructive but bifurcated. Record M&A cycle, AI capex, and pharma innovation support equity growth. However, $40T debt trajectory and potential oil-driven inflation cap multiples. Favor quality, cash-generative names over speculative AI. Stablecoin adoption adds new financial infrastructure layer.
